name: New York
agency: New York State Office of Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation

rule.hpNote: any motorized vessel, no hp threshold
rule.phaseIn: Brianna's Law phase-in by birth year (born on/after Jan 1, 1983 by 2023; on/after Jan 1, 1978 by 2024) ended; all ages since 2025.
rule.textEn: Since 2025, everyone who operates a motorized boat in New York, including a PWC, needs a boating safety certificate, whatever their age.
rule.textEs: Desde 2025, toda persona que maneje una embarcación con motor en Nueva York, incluida una moto acuática, necesita un certificado de seguridad náutica, sin importar su edad.

minAge.note: The course is open from age 10. PWC operators must be 14 or older.

exemptions: Non-motorized boats such as kayaks and canoes.
Adults 18+ renting from a livery, after a safety briefing by livery staff.
Holders of a U.S. Coast Guard license (carry a copy).

card.feeNote: Online providers include the certificate in their course fee; classroom students 18+ buy their certificate online. Replacement $10 at ilostmycard.com.

nonResident: An out-of-state certificate counts only if issued by the boater's current state of residence.
rental: Adults 18+ may rent a motorboat or PWC from a livery without a certificate after a staff safety briefing; under 18 need a certificate.
pwcExtra: Minimum age 14 to operate a PWC.
